review.verdict: The locked-vault side reads instantly, but the right side's floating, disconnected megaphone and the missing two-panel split (a core piece of the brief) blur the second half of the joke and echo the studio's overused blueprint look — needs another pass before publishing.
revisionNotes: Render the two-panel split (vertical divider line + second 'paper' background color on the right) called for in the brief — the whole canvas is currently one flat blue, so the 'Walled Off And Wide Open' contrast the composition depends on is lost.
Rotate megaphone1 to aim down-right at envelope1 instead of out into empty canvas space, and add the dotted line to switch1 so the ad-robot visibly connects to the inbox and the opt-in toggle.
Reshape megaphone1's raw svg into a price-tag silhouette (small loop top + flat tag body) instead of a generic speaker horn so it reads as an ad, not just noise.
Drop or recolor the extra yellow fills (peeker's body, person1's shirt) — the brief calls for a single yellow highlight on cord1's accent dot, and the repeated yellow dilutes that cue.
Tighten switch1's anchor closer to envelope1 (reduce gap, scale to ~1.2) so the OFF toggle reads as part of the inbox rather than a floating prop near person1's foot.
Scale up and shift the peeker/megaphone cluster slightly toward person1 (offset closer, scale 1.1) to fill the empty upper-right quadrant and give the right side a clearer focal point.

review.verdict: Cast and core two-panel metaphor are right, but the ad megaphone prop is unclear (looks like a disconnected floating flag), the cloud clips the safe area, the small robot overlaps the person's face awkwardly, and the split-screen blueprint look repeats recent pieces too closely — average lands below the 3.5 pass bar.
revisionNotes: The price-tag megaphone (megaphone1) reads as a stray floating flag, not a prop held by the peeker robot aimed at the inbox — attach it directly to the robot's arm/hand and angle it so the tip clearly points at envelope-switch.
cloud1 clips outside the safe area per lint warning (x 96…345, y 42…191) — scale it down or shift it inward so the whole shape sits inside the margin.

peeker robot sits on top of person1's head with legs crossing the face, which reads as clipping rather than 'peering over the shoulder' — reattach at side: right with a smaller offset so it rests beside the shoulder, not on the skull.

Brief calls for a thin vertical divider between the two panels; none is present, so the left/right split relies only on spacing — add a simple vertical line component to anchor the two-panel composition.
Scale up or restyle the price-tag shape (clearer notch/tag silhouette) so it unmistakably reads as a megaphone-shaped price tag, since this prop carries the 'ads' half of the joke.

Composition (blueprint palette, split screen, robot+human+cloud+envelope cast) closely echoes several recent pieces (door/OPEN panel, CLOSED robot) — vary panel proportions or accent placement to stand apart.
